# nut completion

Install, inspect, or remove shell completion

```text
Install, inspect, or remove shell completion

Usage: nut completion [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  install
          Install an adapter and verify registration in an isolated real shell
  status
          Inspect installed adapters and probe their registration
  uninstall
          Remove adapters whose bytes still match the recorded manifest
  zsh
          Print the zsh adapter for manual installation
  bash
          Print the bash adapter for manual installation

Options:
      --color <WHEN>
          Color output policy [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --ascii
          Use ASCII symbols and bars
  -j, --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON where supported
  -v, --verbose
          Include additional diagnostic detail
  -c, --config <PATH>
          Read host settings from this file
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## nut completion install

Install an adapter and verify registration in an isolated real shell

```text
Install an adapter and verify registration in an isolated real shell

Usage: nut completion install [OPTIONS] [SHELL]

Arguments:
  [SHELL]
          Shell to install. Defaults to the current `$SHELL` [possible values: zsh, bash]

Options:
      --color <WHEN>
          Color output policy [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
  -n, --dry-run
          Preview without creating files
      --ascii
          Use ASCII symbols and bars
  -t, --target <TARGET>
          Directory in which to install the adapter
  -f, --force
          Replace a foreign or modified adapter
  -j, --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON where supported
  -v, --verbose
          Include additional diagnostic detail
  -c, --config <PATH>
          Read host settings from this file
  -h, --help
          Print help
```
